config.dataset: V128 frozen train 9000-9031 and development validation 10000-10007
config.test_access: FORBIDDEN; do not open test shards or V128 manifest

loss.positive_epsilon: (1-epsilon)*hard_ce + epsilon*uniform_ce over valid legal candidates only
loss.evaluation: standard hard-label cross entropy for every epsilon

config.primary_metric: development validation symbol top1 teacher agreement

calibration.brier: mean multiclass squared error summed over valid candidates

config.selection_rule: smallest epsilon that passes every candidate gate condition
config.canonical_seed_rule: median validation symbol top1 seed for selected epsilon; sort by (top1, numeric seed) and take third

decision: No epsilon passed; no candidate and no online smoke; V150 Weight Decay Audit.
limitations: Development validation has been repeatedly observed since V146; it is not an untouched holdout.
